g.text: The Expanded Studio: Rethinking Artistic Production in the Digital Age

text.style: font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;font-weight:700;font-stretch:normal;font-size:12px;line-height:normal;font-family:'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', Verdana, Geneva, Lucid, Arial, Helvetica, 'Avant Garde', sans-serif;text-anchor:start;fill:#333333

font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;font-weight:normal;font-stretch:normal;font-size:11px;line-height:normal;font-family:'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', Verdana, Geneva, Lucid, Arial, Helvetica, 'Avant Garde', sans-serif;text-anchor:start;fill:#333333
text.tspan: The studio is no longer limited to a physical location.
It includes software, virtual platforms, and cloud-based environments.

text.style: font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;font-weight:700;font-stretch:normal;font-size:12px;line-height:normal;font-family:'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', Verdana, Geneva, Lucid, Arial, Helvetica, 'Avant Garde', sans-serif;text-anchor:start;fill:#333333

font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;font-weight:normal;font-stretch:normal;font-size:11px;line-height:normal;font-family:'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', Verdana, Geneva, Lucid, Arial, Helvetica, 'Avant Garde', sans-serif;text-anchor:start;fill:#333333
text.tspan: Blender, AI systems, 3D scanning, real-time engines, and digital fabrication tools
become integral components of the artist's workflow.

text.style: font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;font-weight:700;font-stretch:normal;font-size:12px;line-height:normal;font-family:'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', Verdana, Geneva, Lucid, Arial, Helvetica, 'Avant Garde', sans-serif;text-anchor:start;fill:#333333

font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;font-weight:normal;font-stretch:normal;font-size:11px;line-height:normal;font-family:'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', Verdana, Geneva, Lucid, Arial, Helvetica, 'Avant Garde', sans-serif;text-anchor:start;fill:#333333
text.tspan: Artists can simulate, test, and modify their works in real-time,
producing multiple virtual iterations before material realization.

text.style: font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;font-weight:700;font-stretch:normal;font-size:12px;line-height:normal;font-family:'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', Verdana, Geneva, Lucid, Arial, Helvetica, 'Avant Garde', sans-serif;text-anchor:start;fill:#333333

font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;font-weight:normal;font-stretch:normal;font-size:11px;line-height:normal;font-family:'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', Verdana, Geneva, Lucid, Arial, Helvetica, 'Avant Garde', sans-serif;text-anchor:start;fill:#333333
text.tspan: Artworks can evolve through viewer interaction, environmental data, or autonomous processes,
shifting from static objects to dynamic systems.

text.style: font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;font-weight:700;font-stretch:normal;font-size:12px;line-height:normal;font-family:'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', Verdana, Geneva, Lucid, Arial, Helvetica, 'Avant Garde', sans-serif;text-anchor:start;fill:#333333

font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;font-weight:normal;font-stretch:normal;font-size:11px;line-height:normal;font-family:'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', Verdana, Geneva, Lucid, Arial, Helvetica, 'Avant Garde', sans-serif;text-anchor:start;fill:#333333
text.tspan: The expanded studio operates as a distributed network of creation, collaboration, and dissemination,
